description: Token savings and latency benchmarks for scripts/bulk-read. Case shapes adapted from spotify/portal-ai-plugins' shunt benchmarks (single large file, source+test pair, multi-file cross-read); fixture content is real production Go source from labstack/echo v5.3.1 (MIT), see evals/fixtures/echo/NOTICE.md.

benchmarks.name: single-large-file
benchmarks.description: Read one large file and summarize its exports
benchmarks.question: What are all the exported types and functions/methods in this file, and what does each one do?

benchmarks.name: source-plus-test
benchmarks.description: Read a source file and its test file to understand coverage
benchmarks.question: What configuration options does the CORS middleware in the first file support, and which of them are exercised by the tests in the second file?

benchmarks.name: multi-file-cross-read
benchmarks.description: Read three unrelated files and answer a cross-cutting question
benchmarks.question: Which exported types are defined across these files, and roughly how many exported methods does each one have?
